newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian Explorers Index edges higher in week.
newsitem.headline: Australian Explorers Index edges higher in week.

text.p: Perth stockbroker Eyres Reed Ltd said its Australian Explorers Index scrambled to a small gain of 53.7 points or 1.71 percent for the week. The All Ordinaries Index rose 1.38 percent.
May 9 May 2 pct 1 Month pct 1 Year pct
NOTE: The explorers index (base 500, March 1992) tracks the performance of 88 small capitalisation exploration companies.
The Eyres Reed Explorer Index edged higher in the week, with junior resource counters surviving fall-out from the Bre-X Indonesia gold scam, Eyres Reed analyst Glen Colgan said in a commentary.
Sentiment had turned decidedly positive by week's end, he said. Gains outnumbered falls four to three.
Strong bounces were recorded by Nugold Hill Mines Nl, up five cents to 10.5 cents, Uranium Australia NL and Defiance Mining NL.
Other strong performances included Ghana Gold, up 5.5 cents to 26.5 cents, after significant drilling resources from the Konongo Concession in Ghana.

Capricorn Resources Australia led the junior nickel division, up 8.5 cents to 43.5 cents, while PNG partners Carpenter Pacific Resources and Ramsgate Resources moved in anticipation of further results from Mt Kare. Carpenter was up 2.5 cents to 36 cents and Ramsgate was up 1.3 cents to nine cents. Victoria Petroleum raced ahead, lifting three cents to 11.5 cents.

Price weakness, often accompanied by thin trading volumes, was seen in Kurnalpi Gold NL down 3.5 cents to 15.5 cents, Equinox Resources NL, off two cents to 24 cents, and Giralia dropped 2.5 cents to 10.5 cents. Other sell-downs included Dalrymple, off eight cents to 30 cents and Leo Shields, down nine cents to 58 cents.
